conventions.support: Revision/hash-pinned LLM visual contact intervals; uncovered times and physical support unknown

actionSpecSchema.title: Animation Studio semantic action specification v1

semanticAuthoring.limitations: Whole movement windows only; positive pose blends; candidate contracts; no verified contact or arbitrary retargeting

units.jointPosition: GLB asset units in parent local space

trackModes.offset: rotation: sampled quaternion multiplied by offset; position: add offset; scale: multiply

limitations: impact ring/debris only; no custom shaders/audio

movementProfiles.units: World distances in normalized meters; local joint quaternions; positions relative to model root
movementProfiles.forward: Model +Z axis transformed by model root rotation; not an inferred anatomical facing
movementProfiles.supportHints: Ball joint within 0.05 m of floor and speed <=0.15 m/s over up to 0.05 s; none means no stationary foot detected, not absence of hand/body contact
movementProfiles.matching: Endpoint heuristic, not complete motion validation. Profiles and reviews invalidate on movement revision. Refresh after import.

movementLibrary.composition: Revision-pinned recipe, explicit connection phases, baked tracks, maximum 4 seconds; smooth pose blending with optional single-foot whole-body anchoring; no IK or balance solver

kickStudy.limitations: Bounded forward kick only; no general IK, collision or automatic balance solver

tools.name: get_contract_reviews
tools.description: Read stored contact/seam reviews and retained history, including stale revision/hash pins. No writes; current manifests hide stale evidence.

tools.name: review_movement_contacts
tools.description: Record bounded source intervals after visual review. Service remeasures contact intent and pins revision/hash; supported decisions require configured height/speed/drift bounds. Uncovered time stays unknown, no automatic anchoring.

tools.name: review_connection_policy
tools.description: Record visual seam review for one curated source pair on an existing compiled recipe. Pins both sources and exact speed/blend/no-anchor configuration. Supported requires no configured flags; needs-review and rejected remain explicit. Does not modify motion.

tools.name: inspect_motion_quality
tools.description: Read-only revision-pinned 60Hz rig inspection for movements or actions: rest bone/scale changes, candidate foot contacts, declared contact drift, root/pelvis travel and finite-difference seam velocities. Returns configured review flags and timestamps, never naturalness approval.

tools.name: find_common_motion
tools.description: Read-only bounded search for shared motion windows between two revision-pinned movements on the current rig. Returns timestamps, normalized extraction ranges, pose errors and separate root travel. Excludes stationary holds by default; fixed-speed comparison, no provenance/contact guarantee.

tools.name: inspect_movement_library
tools.description: Read compact semantic manifests, source hashes, candidate continuation/recovery contracts, profiles and one-step draft specs. Unknown contacts stay unknown. No writes.

tools.name: build_action_spec
tools.description: Validate a typed semantic spec and revision/hash-pinned connections. commit false checks without writing; commit true compiles and saves once with a receipt. Reports structured diagnostics; physical/visual validation remains separate.

spec.title: Animation Studio semantic action specification v1

tools.name: begin_action_run
tools.description: Start a timestamped prompt-to-action run. One active run at a time; subsequent MCP operations are automatically timed, including errors. Call at the beginning of a prompt.

tools.name: append_action_run_event
tools.description: Record an LLM decision, planning step or browser inspection at the current server UTC timestamp. Does not backdate events.

tools.name: finish_action_run
tools.description: Close a tracked run as completed, failed or cancelled with a final note and optional existing action ID.

tools.name: list_action_runs
tools.description: List prompt-to-action run summaries, newest first. Optional action filter. Logs persist independently from motion data.

tools.name: get_action_run
tools.description: Fetch a run with every UTC timestamp, relative time, MCP service duration, result status and LLM notes.

tools.name: revise_action_recipe
tools.description: Revise timings in an existing revision-pinned recipe, recompile, preserve the previous action as reference, and seek preview to the changed section in one operation. Duration sets total playback time for one movement; speed remains bounded 0.5–1.5. Source movements are unchanged.

tools.name: profile_movement_library
tools.description: Measure current movement entry/exit poses, endpoint support hints and root/body travel on the actual rig. Saves revision-bound profiles without changing motions or movement revisions. Hints are not verified contacts.

tools.name: find_movement_connections
tools.description: Rank current profiled movement entries against a source exit. Heuristic pose/contact/travel evidence for LLM selection; not a physical guarantee.

tools.name: review_movement_profile
tools.description: Record endpoint support after visual inspection, with notes. Does not alter motion; profiles invalidate when the movement revision changes.

tools.name: sync_movement_library
tools.description: Add missing adapted UAL2 Standard movements from the installed fixed source package. Never overwrites existing, edited or archived entries. Requires current project sequence.

tools.name: adapt_movement
tools.description: Trim and retime a library movement into a new record or revision, including all tracks, source segments and cues. No arbitrary joint generation. Source and destination revision checks.

tools.name: list_movements
tools.description: List library movements with revisions, source and contact metadata. Includes archived entries when requested.

tools.name: get_movement
tools.description: Read a base movement, metadata and revision before building or composing.

tools.name: register_movement
tools.description: Store or revise a verified Action v2 as a base movement. Use revision 0 for new records; movement IDs start with move-.

tools.name: build_movement
tools.description: Build a base movement from a discovered source clip segment, or an existing action. This tool does not import arbitrary models or generate motion.

tools.name: compose_action
tools.description: Create or revise a baked action from revision-pinned library movements with explicit pose-blend connection phases. Returns contact warnings; not an IK or balance solver.

tools.name: archive_entry
tools.description: Archive or restore a library movement or action without deleting its data. Revision-checked and reversible.

tools.name: revise_kick
tools.description: Create or revise the authored kick study from immutable CC0 baseline. Bounded height correction preserves knee shape; release speed retimes all channels together. Reference stays the baseline.

tools.name: get_capabilities
tools.description: Discover all implemented rig, source clips, track schema, platform tools and limits. Read before authoring.

tools.name: list_actions
tools.description: List persisted actions and revisions, including compact saved recipes for timing revisions.

tools.name: get_action
tools.description: Read full action/reference and revision history. Fetch before a revision.

tools.name: create_action
tools.description: Create a new version-2 action and select it for live preview. Cannot overwrite existing IDs.

tools.name: revise_action
tools.description: Replace an action with fully authored data against expectedRevision. Previous action becomes comparison reference; undo history is retained. Accepts legacy version-1 data from get_action as well.

tools.name: validate_action
tools.description: Validate complete authored data without changing the project.

tools.name: set_preview
tools.description: Control action selection, camera, playhead, playback, speed, loop, comparison, grid and impact visibility. Returns viewer URL.

tools.name: get_diagnostics
tools.description: Measure root height and seven-joint RMS pose speed on the actual rig. Optionally return local/world joint transforms at a timestamp.

tools.name: capture_reference
tools.description: Copy the current action into its comparison reference.

tools.name: restore_revision
tools.description: Restore an earlier action revision as a new revision without deleting history.

tools.name: export_project
tools.description: Return portable project JSON, including current/reference pairs; asset remains a separate dependency.

tools.name: import_project
tools.description: Import an Animation Studio project after validating all action/reference pairs. Existing actions become revisions; no arbitrary file paths.

notes: Version 2 can author all discovered joint channels and new phase sequences.
Rotations use shortest-path quaternion slerp. Offset is post-multiplied on the sampled clip pose.
Root tracks use normalized runtime meters. Choose in-place source clips to avoid double movement.
All writes persist automatically; revision history is retained up to 100 per action.
